messages:
adri: quick drop from design review 1 — prototyped a 'capacity wheel' (radial min/max) inside the compact pool row. link: https://figma.redwood/capacity-wheel-v1

sam: neat visual, but accessibility? pinch/drag patterns need keyboard equivalents.

kevin: agree. propose: keep wheel for mouse/touch, add hidden numeric +/- steppers and a roving tabindex pattern. Expose aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuetext.

olivia: microcopy: rename tooltip from 'Pinwheel' to 'Capacity wheel'. Tooltip copy: "Adjust reserved GPUs (min / max)."

adri: noted. also moved global SLO into header; per-pool shows a tiny "min SLO" pill. If wheel raises min above SLO we show a non-blocking banner.

a11y-bot: a11y notes: ensure wheel control has keyboard focus target, announce changes via aria-live polite: "Min now 3 GPUs, estimated cost +1.2%". Provide sr-only descriptions for compact mode.

sam: when SLO changes globally, show inline cost delta per pool: badge "+2.1% est" and tooltip "Estimated monthly cost change". Keep values to 1 decimal.

kevin: burst confirm language tweak: instead of "Start burst" use "Enable temporary capacity" and include duration + est cost in the dialog. Dialog: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus trap.

olivia: legend: move to top-left as a compact summary on small screens: "4 pools 3 healthy" expandable to full legend.

adri: plan: update figma with keyboard steppers, SR snippets, cost badges, and new copy. pushing v1.1 in ~12h. @kevin @a11y-bot please run keyboard + SR validation, @sam please sanity-check the microcopy.

a11y-bot: Reminder: add prefers-reduced-motion handling for wheel animations and ensure 44px min touch targets.

adri: thanks all 7: will post notes after updates.
